questions.question: Use trace_node with node_name equal to Live Streaming (Douyin/Xiaohongshu) and use filter_flow with min_value equal to 2000.0 and use highlight_path with path equal to Fresh Supermarket (Offline Scan/Delivery), Fresh Food in order to know How do different acquisition channels drive sales across retail business categories?

answer.value: Live Streaming (Douyin/Xiaohongshu) is the largest acquisition channel (6400) and primarily drives Beauty & Skincare (3800). Fresh Supermarket (Offline Scan/Delivery) (5380) mainly contributes to Fresh Food (4200). Fresh Food receives the most total GMV (8150), followed by Beauty & Skincare (4840). The top flow is Fresh Supermarket to Fresh Food (4200), showing offline channels are crucial for fresh products. Community Group (WeChat/Community) (4480) serves both Fresh Food (2600) and Home & Living (1500), indicating community-based shopping patterns.
